vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: mental-health-assistant
Version: 1.0.0

The mental-health-assistant skill bundle is a well-structured set of instructions and reference materials designed to guide an AI agent in providing psychological support. It includes legitimate crisis intervention protocols, standardized assessment scales (PHQ-9, GAD-7), and CBT techniques. The bundle contains no executable code, and the instructions in SKILL.md and the reference files are strictly aligned with the stated purpose, emphasizing safety boundaries such as avoiding medical diagnosis and providing verified crisis hotlines (e.g., 400-161-9995). No evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or harmful prompt injection was found.

llm.guidance: This skill is internally coherent and appears to be what it claims: a conversational mental-health support guide and crisis resource compendium. Before installing, consider: 1) Hotline numbers and regional resources should be checked for accuracy and locality — update if your users are outside the listed regions. 2) The skill is instruction-only and contains no code, but the platform that runs skills may log conversations or send data to its own servers — review your agent/platform privacy and data-retention policies if you will handle sensitive content. 3) The skill explicitly states it is not a replacement for professional diagnosis; ensure your deployment (UI, disclaimers, escalation options) enforces that and that human/clinical escalation paths are available for high-risk users. 4) If you need automated/offline behavior guarantees, verify the host implementation (the README asserts 'offline' behavior, but the platform may still transmit logs).
